title: Godot Editor v4.5 C# build causes Log Spam
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5
- Not Reproducible in 4.4.x


### System information

Godot v4.5.stable.mono - Fedora Linux 42 (Workstation Edition) on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (TGL GT2) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1185G7 @ 3.00GHz (8 threads) - 31.05 GiB memory

### Issue description

The Godot Editor Output is spammed with Error Logs. The same message is repeated over and over (100+ / second). Looks to me like a regression in v4.5, it did work fine in v4.4 and v4.4.1, but I recently only tested it in v4.4.1. But I am not claiming it's not my code causing this issue in 4.5.

It seems to relate to C# Assembly reload after a code change and rebuild.

### Steps to reproduce

1. activate C# plugin [ePlugin Framework](https://github.com/enaweg/godot-epluginframework)
2. rebuild project (possibly making a small code change)
3. AssemblyContext reloads
4. log spam appears

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Cleaned plugin: [ePlugin Framework - Godot 4.5 minimal branch](https://github.com/enaweg/godot-epluginframework/tree/regression/godot-v4.5-test)
An initial rebuild already creates the problem. Restarting the editor works till a new code change and rebuild happens.
